invoice.title: Invoices
invoice.subtitle: Find a till receipt by its transaction number, and download it as a PDF.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the grant for invoices. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

landing.title: Nothing to show yet
landing.hint: Enter a transaction number to find the invoice behind it.

search.required: Enter a transaction number to search.

empty.title: No invoice carries that number
empty.hint: Check the transaction number on the receipt, and clear the store code if you set one.

invoice.capReached: More than 50 invoices matched this number. A full transaction number should match one — check the number before trusting this list.

errors.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the grant for invoices. Ask an administrator if you need it.
errors.searchFailed: That search could not be completed.

confirm.title: This is not a customer receipt
confirm.body: Transaction {{trxNumber}} is a {{trxType}} with the status {{trxStatus}}, not an ordinary sale or return.
confirm.hint: The till holds cash clearances, training receipts and parked sales alongside real ones. This document may not be produced as a receipt.

failure.title: The receipt was not downloaded
failure.quote: Quote this reference to support — it identifies this attempt in the render log.

errors.invalidKey: This row is incomplete, so the receipt could not be requested. Report it if it happens again.
errors.denied: You don't have access to invoices.
errors.renderFailed: This document can't be produced as a receipt. Trying again will not help.
errors.unavailable: The receipt service is unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.timeout: The receipt took too long to produce. Try once more — if it happens again, report it with the reference below.
errors.network: The receipt service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.session: Your session has ended. Sign in again to download the receipt.
errors.generic: The receipt could not be produced.

idocInspector.title: IDoc inspector
idocInspector.subtitle: Look up a transaction and see what the SAP rail generated for it.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the IDoc inspector
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the grant for the IDoc inspector. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

lookup.requiredBoth: Enter a store and a transaction number to look one up.
lookup.requiredStore: Enter a store — a transaction number is only unique within one.
lookup.requiredTrxNumber: Enter a transaction number to look up.

landing.title: Nothing to show yet
landing.hint: Enter a store and a transaction number to see the documents the SAP rail generated for it.

Processed.name: Processed
Processed.sentence: The new SAP rail generated the documents below for this transaction.

ProcessedWithHeldDocuments.name: Held back
ProcessedWithHeldDocuments.sentence: The documents below were generated, and at least one of them was held back from batching.

ProcessedButStampedLegacy.name: Stamped legacy
ProcessedButStampedLegacy.sentence: The documents below were generated by the new rail, while this transaction's own export-version column says the legacy uploader owns it.

Parked.name: Not yet shipped
Parked.sentence: This transaction is on the new rail, but the workflow that would turn it into IDocs has not shipped yet. Nothing went wrong here: the work has not been built, so no document exists and none will until that workflow ships.

Queued.name: Queued
Queued.sentence: This transaction is waiting its turn on the new rail and has not been picked up yet. Look again in a few minutes rather than escalating.

Retrying.name: Retrying
Retrying.sentence: The rail has attempted this transaction and will attempt it again. It has not been given up on, so look again shortly.

GaveUp.name: Abandoned
GaveUp.sentence: The rail stopped trying and produced no IDoc for this transaction, so nothing about it reached SAP. Its queue row carries a processed flag, which records only that the rail stopped handling it — someone needs to look at this transaction.

Legacy.name: Legacy rail
Legacy.sentence: The legacy IDoc uploader owns this transaction, so the new rail generated nothing for it. Take the question to the legacy rail rather than treating the invoice as lost.

StampedNotEnqueued.name: Stamped, not enqueued
StampedNotEnqueued.sentence: This transaction is stamped for the new rail but never reached its queue, so nothing has been generated and nothing is waiting to be. That gap is worth reporting.

NoSuchTransaction.name: No such transaction
NoSuchTransaction.sentence: No transaction with this store and number exists. Check both halves of the key before looking anywhere else — this is a mistyped number far more often than it is a problem.

verdictUnknown.name: Unrecognised verdict
verdictUnknown.sentence: The server answered with a verdict this screen does not know: {{code}}. Nothing has been guessed about what it means. That is worth reporting, and the raw code is what to report.

verdictMissing.name: No verdict
verdictMissing.sentence: The server answered without saying what it found, so there is nothing to report but that. Look the transaction up again, and if it answers this way twice it is worth reporting.

verdictContradiction.name: Contradictory answer
verdictContradiction.sentence: The server answered {{code}}, which means documents were generated, but it sent none of them. Nothing has been hidden here — there was nothing to show. That is worth reporting.

held.title: A document here was held back from batching
held.body: It was generated, but never sealed into an IDoc batch, so SAP has not received it. Every held document is marked on its card below.

disagreement.title: This transaction is also stamped for the legacy uploader
disagreement.body: The documents below were generated by the new rail, while this transaction's export-version column says {{exportVersion}}. The legacy uploader claims that value too, so this transaction may have been exported by both rails.
disagreement.bodyBlank: The documents below were generated by the new rail, while this transaction's export-version column is empty. The legacy uploader claims an empty value as its own, so this transaction may have been exported by both rails.
disagreement.bodyUnstated: The documents below were generated by the new rail, while this transaction's export-version column says the legacy uploader owns it. The server did not send the offending value, so it is not quoted here. This transaction may have been exported by both rails.
disagreement.footer: This screen only names the disagreement. It diagnoses nothing and changes nothing.

unknownVerdict.title: Unrecognised verdict
unknownVerdict.body: The server answered {{code}}, which this screen does not know. What is shown below is everything that arrived, unchanged — but the answer to "why does it look like this" is not on this screen. Report the raw code.

unknownAttention.title: Unrecognised finding
unknownAttention.body: The server flagged this transaction with {{code}}, which this screen does not know. Nothing has been guessed about it. Report the raw code.

errors.lookupFailed: That transaction could not be looked up.

download.actionAria: Download the {{idocType}} XML for this transaction
download.caveat: This XML is rebuilt from the database rows as they stand now. It is not the file SAP received.

errors.invalidKey: That download was asked for without a complete store and transaction number. Report it if it happens again.
errors.typeRequired: That download was asked for without an IDoc type. Report it if it happens again.
errors.notPresent: This transaction has no document of that IDoc type, so there is nothing to download. Report it if it happens again — the buttons here are drawn from the documents above.
errors.notSerialisable: There is no serialiser for that IDoc type, so no file can be produced for it. That is worth reporting.
errors.denied: You don't have access to the IDoc inspector's downloads.
errors.session: Your session has ended, so the file could not be fetched. Sign in again.
errors.network: The file could not be fetched because the server could not be reached. Try again.
errors.generic: That file could not be produced.

lines.none: This document carries no line items.
lines.noneForTag: No line on this document was minted by that source.

expansion.noConditionsForTag: No condition on this line was minted by that source.
expansion.xmlBlanked: This amount is stored on the row but written blank in the exported XML.

provenance.unknownHint: This row carries no source tag, so where it came from is unknown. It is not a POS line.

payments.title: Payments
payments.noProvenance: — these rows carry no source tag at all

fi.title: FI lines
fi.noProvenance: — these rows carry no source tag at all
fi.none: This financial document came back with no FI lines. That is worth reporting: an FI document should always carry them.

blank.discTypeHint: No SAP posting code was found for this condition when the document was generated. That is a defect worth reporting, not an ordinary blank.
